scope: Operational decision-library v1: six project patterns and declared lifecycle domains; not an exhaustive universe of software engineering.
authority: All guidance is proposed; local observations never establish production readiness or human approval.

domains.title: Intent and acceptance contracts
domains.claim_scope: The planner requires distinct intent and requirements artifacts. It cannot determine whether a product solves a real problem.
domains.adopter_evidence_required: User research, agreed outcomes, excluded scope and falsifiable acceptance examples.

domains.title: Risk and context selection
domains.claim_scope: Conditional workflow gates change with project type, data, risk, workload, hosting and effects. Profile values remain caller assertions.
domains.adopter_evidence_required: Owner-reviewed data classification, real workload, budget, threat context and provider limits.

domains.title: Architecture selection and evolution
domains.claim_scope: Contextual architecture matrices and migration boundaries; no topology benchmark or universal stack prescription.
domains.adopter_evidence_required: Measured constraints, ADR, component ownership, consistency and migration drills.

domains.title: Hosting and self-hosting
domains.claim_scope: Guidance for operational ownership, isolation, exit and deployment choices. No infrastructure is provisioned.
domains.adopter_evidence_required: Selected provider/server configuration, TLS, patching, backups, access and recovery evidence.

domains.title: Independent review and evidence authority
domains.claim_scope: Assessment rejects same producer/reviewer label and never grants production authority. Labels are not authenticated identities.
domains.adopter_evidence_required: Actual independent review, protected merge/release permissions and verified human decisions.

domains.title: Revision, artifact and evidence freshness
domains.claim_scope: Recorded observations bind artifacts and exact profile/plan/project identities, and age at declared as_of. Statements can still be fabricated.
domains.adopter_evidence_required: Trusted execution records, current assessment time, artifact retrieval and independent inspection.

domains.title: Tenant and object authorization
domains.claim_scope: Synthetic HTTP principals cannot read/write/export/consume another fixture tenant.
domains.adopter_evidence_required: Real identity/session, all endpoints/jobs/export paths, storage policies and revocation.

domains.title: Identity, authentication and sessions
domains.claim_scope: Mechanism guidance only: synthetic bearer tokens and fixture approval issuers are not production identity systems.
domains.adopter_evidence_required: Chosen IdP/session/authentication/revocation/recovery and CSRF integration tests.

domains.title: Privacy, retention and deletion
domains.claim_scope: Data-lifecycle guidance; no jurisdictional legal compliance or real deletion audit.
domains.adopter_evidence_required: Data inventory, lawful basis where applicable, retention/deletion propagation and backup treatment.

domains.title: Dependencies and supply chain
domains.claim_scope: Pinned library dependencies/actions and published website notice inventory; not an adopter SBOM/signature assessment.
domains.adopter_evidence_required: Dependency provenance, vulnerability reachability, build attestations, secrets and deploy identity.

domains.title: Idempotent operations and conflicts
domains.claim_scope: Local tenant/action/operation-key replay, fingerprint conflict and simultaneous duplicate effects.
domains.adopter_evidence_required: Actual store isolation, provider idempotency contract, retention/window and reconciliation.

domains.title: Concurrent writes and version contracts
domains.claim_scope: SQLite fixture optimistic version races have one accepted winner. This does not establish PostgreSQL behavior.
domains.adopter_evidence_required: Selected database isolation, lock/retry budget, skew and real schema load.

domains.title: Transactional outbox and consumer effects
domains.claim_scope: Local atomic write/outbox plus duplicate-safe projection; unknown event schema is not acknowledged.
domains.adopter_evidence_required: Broker semantics, ordering/partition design, consumer ownership, dead-letter and replay procedures.

domains.title: Crash boundaries and data recovery
domains.claim_scope: Child-process termination and reopened local SQLite state, not power loss, replica or storage-device failure.
domains.adopter_evidence_required: Store-specific durability, process/node/region failure and integrity checks.

domains.title: Migration, snapshot restore and rollback boundary
domains.claim_scope: Fixture v1-to-v2 compatibility and isolated new-file restore, with post-snapshot write loss explicit.
domains.adopter_evidence_required: Real schema/data volume, compatibility window, RPO/RTO, post-cutover writer and external-effect reconciliation.

domains.title: Bounded overload and useful recovery
domains.claim_scope: A short closed-model loopback fixture experiment observes admission rejection and subsequent integrity/recovery.
domains.adopter_evidence_required: Production-shaped arrival mix, generator adequacy, agreed ceilings, real tails and recovery objectives.

domains.title: Spike, soak and large-scale capacity
domains.claim_scope: Selection and workload methodology; no long-duration soak, distributed generator or million-user claim.
domains.adopter_evidence_required: Approved real workload experiment spanning lifecycle, saturation and recovery, with uncertainty and costs.

domains.title: Frontend state, cancellation and races
domains.claim_scope: Pure state and transport tests protect request identity, cancelled work and explicit retries.
domains.adopter_evidence_required: Real app routing, cache ownership, compatibility and component interactions.

domains.title: Untrusted frontend output
domains.claim_scope: Actual Chromium renders the hostile fixture as text without inserted active nodes.
domains.adopter_evidence_required: All production rendering/URL/HTML sinks and server policy; this is not general XSS clearance.

domains.title: Browser usability and limited accessibility
domains.claim_scope: Selected keyboard, accessible-name, focus and390px layout observations in one browser.
domains.adopter_evidence_required: Assistive technology, zoom, contrast, device/browser matrix and complete applicable WCAG assessment.

domains.title: API and event compatibility
domains.claim_scope: Local fixture request/schema/unknown-event rejection. No real consumer fleet tested.
domains.adopter_evidence_required: Versioned external consumer contracts, supported clients, serialization and rollout compatibility.

domains.title: Mobile and offline synchronization
domains.claim_scope: Mobile-backend playbook covers retry/conflict/cursor/revision decisions; no native client or offline sync implementation.
domains.adopter_evidence_required: Real device lifecycle, stale clients, sync epochs, conflicts, consent and notification behavior.

domains.title: Authorization before model context
domains.claim_scope: Synthetic tenant/task/revocation rules are checked before documents reach the deterministic fixture model.
domains.adopter_evidence_required: Actual retrieval indexes, policy freshness, connectors and provider data boundary.

domains.title: Untrusted instructions and tool authority
domains.claim_scope: Adversarial fixture content cannot broaden deterministic tool scope or issue an approval. No model robustness claim follows.
domains.adopter_evidence_required: Evaluated real model/provider/tool behavior with independent policy enforcement and adversarial cases.

domains.title: Exact-action approval and revocation
domains.claim_scope: Trusted local fixture authority binds capability to run/task/tenant/revision/action/expiry. It is not a human identity service.
domains.adopter_evidence_required: Authenticated human action, transport/session protection, real revocation and audited policy service.

domains.title: Uncertain external effects and reconciliation
domains.claim_scope: Independent local provider ledger reconciles simulated crash/reopen; missing/mismatched receipts remain unresolved.
domains.adopter_evidence_required: Real provider receipts/idempotency, settlement, partial effect and manual reconciliation procedures.

domains.title: Agent budgets, deadlines and cancellation
domains.claim_scope: Synthetic units and call caps survive restart; cancellation/deadlines are rechecked. They are not real currency/provider spending caps.
domains.adopter_evidence_required: Provider/account enforcement, in-flight billing, distributed cancellation and actual cost telemetry.

domains.title: Model quality and evaluation limits
domains.claim_scope: Versioned deterministic policy cases and oracles; live-model quality is explicitly unrun, not scored as a pass.
domains.adopter_evidence_required: Held-out project tasks, evaluated model version, stochastic repeatability, factual quality and human adjudication.

domains.title: Selecting falsifiable tests
domains.claim_scope: Three-axis selection guidance and test-plan skill; coverage metrics do not establish requirement correctness.
domains.adopter_evidence_required: Project risk argument, fixtures, genuine oracles, negative controls and retained outcomes.

domains.title: GitHub versioning and delivery
domains.claim_scope: Branch/PR/review/versioning policy and proposed Actions; no claim that an adopter ruleset is enforced.
domains.adopter_evidence_required: Actual repository rulesets, owner review, provenance, CI on final commit and rollback.

domains.title: Release readiness and handoff
domains.claim_scope: Required gate assertions cannot silently bypass missing/failed/unrun dependencies or become human authority.
domains.adopter_evidence_required: Real artifact/runbooks/restore results, actual human approval and target-environment rollout.

domains.title: Observability, service objectives and on-call
domains.claim_scope: SLI/SLO/alerting/health guidance; local fixture counters are not a deployed telemetry platform.
domains.adopter_evidence_required: Real journey/error budget, alert delivery, logs/traces/privacy and accountable on-call.

domains.title: Incident, evolution and retirement readiness
domains.claim_scope: Planner requires pre-release operational readiness and includes later incident/evolution/retirement stages; no real incident or teardown executed.
domains.adopter_evidence_required: Exercises, owner/successor, communication scope, provider export, retention and approved destructive cleanup.

domains.title: Evidence, translations and original writing
domains.claim_scope: Library source monitoring, source/license pins, four-language review and private generation boundary; not legal clearance.
domains.adopter_evidence_required: Continuing semantic/source rights review, translation review, private generation setup and actual human merge.

domains.title: Agent host, MCP and WebMCP
domains.claim_scope: Read-only local MCP and host skills; native WebMCP and remote ChatGPT connector remain compatibility/deployment work.
domains.adopter_evidence_required: Host installation, transport/authentication/privacy/rate limiting and real tool invocation at supported versions.

extensions_requiring_separate_project_ev: Native mobile clients and device integration
Distributed multi-region failover and disaster recovery
Production identity, billing and provider integrations
